item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports Egypt's reported account that terrorist attacks were brought under control after 30 June 2013 and that arrest, search, pretrial-detention, and criminal-trial rules did not go beyond the Criminal Procedure Code and Counter-Terrorism Act."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E019","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt does not contain the claimed November 2019–May 2023 figures, 769 employees, violation counts, or five torture convictions."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt identifies Egypt among the eight remaining Annex 2 hold-out states that must ratify for the CTBT to enter into force and states that no serious consideration of ratification had occurred by any remaining Annex 2 state in several years."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E021","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt’s foreign minister rejected plans to transfer Palestinians away from their land and said that unless the conflict’s root causes were addressed and the Israeli occupation ended, new cycles of violence would unfold.","notes":["The excerpt supports the rejection of transfer and the causal warning about root causes, occupation, and renewed violence.","It does not attribute a ceasefire call or humanitarian action to Egypt’s foreign minister in the quoted passage."]}]}
